na4b030434c.headline: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies :  Vale and Wabtec Finalize Locomotive Purchase Agreement
na4b030434c.summary: Vale agreed with Wabtec to acquire 50 new Evolution Series locomotives for its Vitória a Minas and Carajás railroads. The order is a major step in Vale's fleet renewal.
na4b030434c.why: Vale is a major Brazilian mining company whose rail network moves iron ore. Wabtec is a US maker of locomotives and rail equipment.

impacts.name: Vale
impacts.why: Vale is buying the locomotives for its rail fleet, a capital expenditure.

n1dd2b6f6f8.headline: DN Agrar estimates increasing revenues and profits for this year
n1dd2b6f6f8.summary: Livestock farm operator DN Agrar has budgeted operating income of 312.6 million lei, up 18%, and estimated net profit of 38.8 million lei, up 22% from 2024, per its Bucharest Stock Exchange reports.
n1dd2b6f6f8.why: DN Agrar is a Romanian livestock farm operator listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange, and its budgets indicate expected earnings for investors in the company.

n36aa0c64d6.headline: Zenith Bank Achieves Double Digit Growth In Gross Earnings, Proposes N4.00 Final Dividend In Full Year 2024
n36aa0c64d6.summary: Zenith Bank Plc reported audited results for the year ended December 31, 2024, showing significant growth across key performance measures. It proposed a N4.00 final dividend.
n36aa0c64d6.why: Zenith Bank is one of Nigeria's largest commercial lenders. Its earnings and dividend policy are watched as indicators of the health of Nigeria's banking sector.

nd65f400964.headline: Mexican auto industry on edge after Trump’s new tariffs on imported cars
nd65f400964.summary: Mexican exporters are confident they can bypass much of the new US tariff on imported cars. Auto parts meeting USMCA requirements will be temporarily exempt.
nd65f400964.why: Mexico is a major auto exporter to the United States, and USMCA governs tariff treatment of North American vehicles and parts. Tariff changes affect automakers' margins and supply chains.
nd65f400964.why_moved: New US tariffs on imported cars threaten Mexican auto exports, although USMCA-compliant auto parts are temporarily exempt, which exporters see as limiting the impact.

nd8bf49d636.headline: US car tariffs puts focus on treatment of Tesla
nd8bf49d636.summary: Tesla's largest shareholder, Elon Musk, is a senior adviser to President Donald Trump. The article examines how the new US car tariffs could affect the electric carmaker.
nd8bf49d636.why: Tesla is a major US electric vehicle maker with production and supply chains spanning several countries. Trade policy on vehicles directly affects its costs and competitiveness.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: US car tariffs may change the cost and treatment of Tesla's vehicles and parts.

nfda7f40875.headline: Transelectrica wants to distribute a quarter of last year's profit as dividends
nfda7f40875.summary: Transelectrica's board proposed allocating 155.4 million lei of last year's 585.9 million lei profit as dividends, ahead of the April 29 shareholder meeting.
nfda7f40875.why: Transelectrica is Romania's electricity transmission operator, and its dividend policy matters to shareholders of the Bucharest-listed utility.

n18c93501e6.headline: Travelodge sees slower start to 2025 despite Crufts and Six Nations boost
n18c93501e6.summary: Travelodge said trading started 2025 more slowly despite boosts from Crufts and the Six Nations, and it hopes for a pick-up over the year ahead.
n18c93501e6.why: Travelodge is a UK budget hotel chain, and its trading updates signal demand in the UK leisure and travel sector.

nffd93c9c7f.headline: Ringgit ends lower against greenback due to tariff concerns
nffd93c9c7f.summary: The ringgit weakened against the US dollar alongside other ASEAN currencies as traders and investors worried about reciprocal tariffs the US is set to impose on April 2.
nffd93c9c7f.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves matter for exporters, importers and foreign investors in Malaysian assets. US tariff policy is a major driver of Asian currency and trade sentiment.

n1280e58bf0.headline: What will be new Petrol, Diesel prices in Pakistan from April 1, 2025?
n1280e58bf0.summary: Petrol and diesel prices in Pakistan are expected to be reduced from April 1, 2025, providing relief around Eid-ul-Fitr.
n1280e58bf0.why: Fuel prices in Pakistan are set periodically by the government and feed into transport costs, inflation and the central bank's policy outlook.

n1cc0c41a59.headline: Dave Ramsey Just Found Out You Can Split Your DoorDash Into Four Payments. The Look On His Face Says It All
n1cc0c41a59.summary: DoorDash and Klarna have a partnership that allows customers to split food delivery payments into four interest-free installments, drawing criticism from some debt-averse commentators.
n1cc0c41a59.why: DoorDash is a US food delivery platform, and buy-now-pay-later partnerships like this one affect consumer spending and credit exposure for merchants and lenders.

n6bd7f694c7.headline: Reeves ‘absolutely certain’ welfare cuts will not push people into poverty
n6bd7f694c7.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves said she is 'absolutely certain' welfare cuts will not push people into poverty. She denied there will be further tax rises or spending cuts at the autumn budget.
n6bd7f694c7.why: The Chancellor of the Exchequer sets UK fiscal policy, so decisions on taxes, spending and the budget affect gilt yields, sterling and domestic sectors.

n28fe6b73c2.headline: 'I don’t want to call it evil, but it was backward' – Prof. Bokpin on scrapped E-Levy
n28fe6b73c2.summary: Ghana's government has scrapped the electronic levy (E-Levy), which economics professor Godfred Alufar Bokpin called a much-needed correction to a 'poorly designed' policy. The item was published by MyJoyOnline.
n28fe6b73c2.why: Changes to levies on digital payments affect tax revenue, consumer transaction costs and the fiscal position of the Ghanaian government.

n637225c7e4.headline: Cheaper power bills pledge as Dutton spurs gas supply
n637225c7e4.summary: Opposition Leader Peter Dutton's budget reply outlined an alternative vision to drive down energy costs and ease pressures. The plan includes spurring gas supply.
n637225c7e4.why: Energy prices and gas supply policy influence industrial costs, utility bills and the outlook for Australia's gas producers and power sector.

ne3a628432c.headline: Exclusive-Italy pursues payment from Meta, X and LinkedIn in landmark tax case
ne3a628432c.summary: Italy has handed tax demands to Meta, X and LinkedIn in an unprecedented VAT claim against the US tech companies. The claim could have repercussions across the European Union, according to four sources.
ne3a628432c.why: Meta owns Facebook and Instagram, and LinkedIn is owned by Microsoft. Tax disputes over digital services can affect these companies' European earnings and regulatory exposure.

na99f65d20c.headline: New record high number of children in poverty in UK
na99f65d20c.summary: The latest figure shows a record high number of children in poverty in the UK. It is the highest since comparable records began in 2002/03.
na99f65d20c.why: Child poverty levels reflect labour market conditions, welfare policy and household incomes, which feed into UK fiscal and social spending debates.

n032e8205e0.headline: LTA Suspends Surcharges on International Calls Between Liberia, Sierra Leone, and The Gambia
n032e8205e0.summary: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority has suspended surcharges on international calls between Liberia, Sierra Leone and The Gambia. The announcement was made in Paynesville, Liberia.
n032e8205e0.why: Telecom regulators set rules on call pricing, which affects operator revenues and consumer costs in cross-border communications.

n19eee33446.headline: Australia to hold general election on May 3
n19eee33446.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese triggered a general election by visiting the governor-general's residence on Friday. The election is set for May 3.
n19eee33446.why: Australian elections decide the government that sets fiscal, tax and trade policy for the country's economy, which affects investors in its assets.

n5fbb4c3980.headline: Trump bases auto tariffs on national security. Can he do that?
n5fbb4c3980.summary: President Donald Trump justified a 25% tariff on imported autos and auto parts under Section 232, a national security provision. The article explains what that legal basis means.
n5fbb4c3980.why: Section 232 of the US Trade Expansion Act allows tariffs on imports deemed a threat to national security. Auto tariffs affect global carmakers, parts suppliers and trade flows.
n5fbb4c3980.why_moved: The tariff applies a 25% rate to imported autos and auto parts under Section 232, a national security basis for trade measures.

nb6312e7a4e.headline: Sri Lanka sells extra Rs519mn Treasury bills after auction
nb6312e7a4e.summary: Sri Lanka sold 519 million rupees of Treasury bills offered on tap after the auction. Average rates were 7.50% and 8.25%, the state debt office said.
nb6312e7a4e.why: Treasury bill auctions set short-term government borrowing costs and signal domestic rate levels for investors in Sri Lankan debt.

n4e31302336.headline: Three in 10 children living in poverty, ‘shameful’ record figures show
n4e31302336.summary: At least 200,000 more children were living in poverty in the UK in 2024 compared with 2023, according to the latest figures. Three in 10 children are now in poverty.
n4e31302336.why: Child poverty statistics feed into UK social spending debates and fiscal policy decisions set by the Treasury.

n1b8cb9ee1d.headline: Indian banks' loan growth slows for eighth straight month in February, RBI data shows
n1b8cb9ee1d.summary: Loan growth at Indian banks moderated for an eighth straight month in February, central bank data showed, due to lower personal and credit card loans after tighter rules.
n1b8cb9ee1d.why: Bank credit growth is a key gauge of economic activity and lending conditions in India, which affects banking-sector earnings.

nfee494467d.headline: Vaccines group Gavi says U.S. has not confirmed it will end funding
nfee494467d.summary: The head of vaccines group Gavi says it has not received confirmation from the US government about losing more than $1 billion in pledged funding under a reported aid-cut proposal.
nfee494467d.why: Gavi is a global vaccine alliance funded by governments and donors, so its financing affects pharmaceutical supply chains and global health spending.

n68b70aa637.headline: Auto stocks slide as US tariffs send
n68b70aa637.summary: Global automaker shares fell on Thursday after President Trump imposed a 25% import tax on vehicles not built in the US, raising concerns over global trade and industry profits.
n68b70aa637.why: Automakers are highly exposed to cross-border supply chains and export markets, so tariffs directly affect their costs and profit margins.
n68b70aa637.why_moved: The 25% import tax on non-US-built vehicles raised worries over global trade and potential hits to automaker profits, sending shares lower.

n5541db54e7.headline: Brazilian President Lula swipes at Trump as US imposes auto tariffs
n5541db54e7.summary: Brazilian President Lula da Silva criticised Donald Trump's decision to raise tariffs on a wide range of products. The move includes auto tariffs imposed by the United States.
n5541db54e7.why: US tariffs on autos and other goods affect global supply chains and trade flows with partners such as Brazil.

nbd48846b68.headline: Australia to hold general elections on May 3 with inflation and a housing shortage major issues
nbd48846b68.summary: Australians will go to the polls on May 3, with high costs of living and a housing shortage as key issues. The issues are likely to weigh against the government.
nbd48846b68.why: Election outcomes shape fiscal policy, housing measures and regulation that affect the Australian economy and markets.

nee23f9667d.headline: Closing Bell Movers: GameStop gains 7% on earnings, bitcoin announcement
nee23f9667d.summary: GameStop shares rose 7% after earnings and a bitcoin announcement. Broader US stock futures were up marginally in the evening session.
nee23f9667d.why: GameStop is a US video game retailer whose share price is closely watched by retail and speculative investors. Its results and crypto moves attract wide attention.

impacts.name: GameStop
impacts.why: Shares rose 7% on earnings and a bitcoin announcement, per the headline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nee23f9667d.why_moved: The shares rose after earnings and a bitcoin announcement, according to the headline.

nb5f98385d3.headline: EV supporters slam Dutton's proposed fuel excise cut
nb5f98385d3.summary: Australia's two largest electric vehicle peak bodies have opposed a proposed halving of the fuel excise. The proposal is from the opposition leader Dutton, according to the headline.
nb5f98385d3.why: Fuel excise is a tax on petrol and diesel, and changes to it affect fuel prices and the relative appeal of electric vehicles.

n0f043b89c0.headline: Trump announces 25% tariffs on imported cars and parts
n0f043b89c0.summary: The US administration announced 25% tariffs on imported cars and auto parts. The President said the move will boost US manufacturing and encourage companies to relocate operations to the United States.
n0f043b89c0.why: Automakers and parts suppliers that import vehicles and components into the US face higher costs, which can affect margins, pricing and supply chains.
n0f043b89c0.why_moved: The 25% tariffs on imported cars and parts raise the cost of imported vehicles and components, which pressures automaker margins and could lift new car prices.

na65096cf31.headline: Trump administration abruptly cuts billions from state health services
na65096cf31.summary: The Trump administration abruptly cut billions of dollars in funding for state health services. The input gives no further detail on the programmes affected or the reasons for the cuts.
na65096cf31.why: Federal health funding flows to US states and shapes spending by healthcare providers and public health programmes.

n24dcd57818.headline: Kāinga Ora sells up state houses in Auckland’s wealthy suburbs
n24dcd57818.summary: Kāinga Ora is selling state houses in Auckland's wealthy suburbs, and said it has been waiting on final building approval from Auckland Council.
n24dcd57818.why: Kāinga Ora is New Zealand's state housing agency, and its asset sales affect the public housing portfolio and government finances.

n5a4c26d7f3.headline: German Logistics Giant With 100 Workers in Northport & Vance Criticizes Trump Tariffs
n5a4c26d7f3.summary: A German logistics company employing 100 people in Tuscaloosa County said there will be no winners after President Donald Trump announced a new 25 percent tariff on all car imports.
n5a4c26d7f3.why: Tariffs on car imports raise costs for automakers and suppliers, and affect logistics firms that move vehicles and parts across borders.

n028e218628.headline: In the news today: Carney's campaign presses pause as new U.S. auto tariffs announced
n028e218628.summary: Liberal leader Mark Carney returned to Ottawa to respond to new US auto tariffs, which have disrupted his campaign plans.
n028e218628.why: US tariffs on autos affect Canada's auto manufacturing and export sector, which is closely integrated with US supply chains.

n8b5ab126d8.headline: Gas supply to urea plants extended for three months
n8b5ab126d8.summary: A meeting led by Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar decided to extend gas supply to urea plants for three months. The decision aims to keep fertiliser available to farmers.
n8b5ab126d8.why: Urea fertiliser is produced from natural gas, so gas allocation decisions directly affect fertiliser supply and agricultural costs.

n8c6d7367d0.headline: Das auto caught in the tariff crosshairs
n8c6d7367d0.summary: Investors will focus on European auto stocks after Trump announced duties on imported cars and light trucks. The day-ahead preview covers European and global markets.
n8c6d7367d0.why: European carmakers export large volumes of vehicles to the United States, so new US import duties directly affect their pricing and margins.
n8c6d7367d0.why_moved: Investors are focused on European auto stocks after Trump announced duties on imported cars and light trucks.

nf50c9b6739.headline: Economic growth almost steady in second quarter
nf50c9b6739.summary: Pakistan's overall economic growth was almost steady in the second quarter. Contraction in the industrial sector dragged down overall performance.
nf50c9b6739.why: Quarterly GDP growth indicates the health of an economy and influences monetary policy and investor decisions on Pakistani assets. Industrial output is a key component of GDP.

n50df9348c3.headline: EU Regrets US Car Tariffs - Canada Condemns Attack
n50df9348c3.summary: The EU expressed deep regret over Trump's 25% tariffs on car imports. Canada called the measure an attack on workers.
n50df9348c3.why: US tariffs on car imports affect automakers that export vehicles and parts across borders. Trade disputes can alter supply chains and pricing for carmakers.

n1b4abd719b.headline: Budget FY26: FBR examining proposals of Cellular Mobile Operators
n1b4abd719b.summary: The Federal Board of Revenue is examining budget proposals submitted by cellular mobile operators ahead of the FY26 budget.
n1b4abd719b.why: Telecom tax measures affect the profitability of mobile operators, which are major listed companies in Pakistan.

n384a603f4d.headline: FBM KLCI climbs 12pts as bargain-hunting continues
n384a603f4d.summary: The FBM KLCI rose 12 points in Thursday morning trade as buying in selected heavyweight stocks continued despite investor concern over developments in Trump's tariff war.
n384a603f4d.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark index of its largest listed companies and reflects regional trade sentiment.

n11e80c3619.headline: Markets rebound in early trade amid foreign fund inflows
n11e80c3619.summary: Indian equities rebounded in early trade, supported by foreign fund inflows. Larsen & Toubro, Zomato, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, NTPC, Titan, Power Grid and Reliance Industries were the biggest gainers.
n11e80c3619.why: India's benchmark indexes track large listed companies, and foreign portfolio flows are a major driver of Indian equity prices and the rupee.
n11e80c3619.why_moved: Foreign fund inflows supported a rebound in early trade, with large-cap heavyweights leading the gains.

n7723f5c352.headline: Govt claims Rs3.5tr saved through revised power deals
n7723f5c352.summary: The government claims Rs3.5 trillion has been saved through revised power purchase deals. A cabinet decision returned the solar net-metering policy for review, a Senate body was told.
n7723f5c352.why: Power purchase agreements set the cost of electricity for Pakistan's grid, which affects fiscal pressure, circular debt and consumer tariffs.

n978c215f1a.headline: IMF approves $1.3 billion loan package for Pakistan
n978c215f1a.summary: The IMF has reached a staff-level agreement with Pakistan on a $1.3 billion loan package over 28 months. The deal is designed to support the country's economy.
n978c215f1a.why: The IMF is the Washington-based lender that provides balance-of-payments support to member countries, often with conditions on fiscal and economic policy. Its agreements shape sovereign creditworthiness and investor sentiment.

ndb00d39f8c.headline: French deficit came in lower than expected in 2024 but risks remain
ndb00d39f8c.summary: France's public deficit was 5.8% of GDP in 2024, below the expected 6%. The economy minister said the outcome was "not good news" despite the better figure.
ndb00d39f8c.why: Budget deficits and debt levels drive French government bond yields and the eurozone's fiscal debate. Investors track them closely for sovereign risk.

na64ad6706a.headline: Stocks rally 1,139 points on IMF agreement
na64ad6706a.summary: Pakistani equities rallied 1,139 points after the country reached a long-awaited staff-level agreement with the International Monetary Fund. The market responded to the deal's achievement.
na64ad6706a.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's benchmark index of large listed companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its moves reflect domestic sentiment and macroeconomic policy.
na64ad6706a.why_moved: Investors reacted to the achievement of a long-awaited IMF staff-level agreement, which the report links to the rally.

n9b103845ea.headline: DNO reports oil and gas discovery in North Sea license PL1182 S
n9b103845ea.summary: Norwegian operator DNO has reported an oil and gas discovery in the northern North Sea licence PL1182 S, where it holds a 40% operated interest.
n9b103845ea.why: DNO is a Norwegian oil and gas company with upstream assets in the North Sea and elsewhere. Discoveries can add to reserves and future production.

nb58974a956.headline: T-bill yields jump by up to 34bps, surpass policy rate
nb58974a956.summary: Treasury bill yields in Pakistan jumped by up to 34 basis points and now exceed the policy rate. Experts believe banks expect the government to borrow heavily to reduce circular debt.
nb58974a956.why: Treasury bill yields reflect short-term government borrowing costs and set the benchmark for money-market rates. Yields above the policy rate signal tighter funding conditions.

n95cb0c4223.headline: Markets today: Wall Street slips following Trump’s latest tariffs, despite solid economic data
n95cb0c4223.summary: US stocks were pulled in different directions as the latest tariff escalation created winners and losers among auto stocks, while better-than-expected economic data supported the market.
n95cb0c4223.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US-listed companies and is a benchmark for global equity performance. Tariffs affect import costs and margins across manufacturing sectors such as autos.
n95cb0c4223.why_moved: The new tariff escalation hit sentiment and created sector-specific winners and losers, while better-than-expected economic data offset some of the pressure.

n0e9beaba50.headline: Military stores prepare for tariffs, aiming to keep costs down
n0e9beaba50.summary: Military store officials expect tariffs to affect exchanges, including the availability and cost of certain items. They are seeking to keep costs down.
n0e9beaba50.why: Tariffs raise import costs for retailers and suppliers, and government-run retail exchanges pass costs on to service members.
